ma.capsuleStyle(Object object)

Set capsule style(Minimum version: 24.3.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
style Number Yes Capsule style, valid value range is 0\1.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
  1. host app is in light mode;
  2. host app is in dark mode.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String capsuleStyle: ok

Sample Code

// Support promise
ma.capsuleStyle({ style: 0 }).then(res => {
  console.log(res);
});

// Support callback
ma.capsuleStyle({
  style: 1,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  complete(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});
